events.text: Married King Ferdinand II of Aragon in March 1506.

evidence.quote: between Ferdinand ( aged 54 ) and Germaine ( aged 18 ) , took place in March 1506

events.text: Ferdinand II died, leaving Germaine a widow.

evidence.quote: Ferdinand died after two years of health problems in 1516 , leaving Germaine a widow

events.text: Moved from Aragon to Castile to join the court of Charles V.

evidence.quote: Germaine moved from Aragon to Castile to join his court as well

events.text: Moved with Charles V from Castile to Aragon.

evidence.quote: Charles V , Germaine , and Charles Vs sister Eleanor moved from Castile to Aragon in 1519

events.text: Appointed jointly with her husband as viceroys of Valencia.

evidence.quote: In 1523 Charles V appointed the couple jointly viceroys of Valencia

events.label: pardon
events.text: Signed a pardon officially ending persecution of rebellion participants.

evidence.quote: Germaine signed a pardon that officially ended the persecution of all former participants in the rebellion

events.text: Her first husband, Johann of Brandenburg-Ansbach, died.

evidence.quote: Next year after Johanns death in 1525
Next year after Johanns death in 1525 , Germaine married Ferdinand , Duke of Calabria
Germaine died on 15 October 1536 in Liria
